meta.description: Baseline input for one concert. The promoter's ticketing operations team fills it in before the event. Every value is a fact, a decision, or an estimate that a person can give. Opsidio derives arrival curves and other demand data from these inputs.
meta.masking: Fictional event at a real venue. Venue facts come from the public sources listed under sources. The event name, artist, promoter, date, prices, quotas, sales, staffing, equipment, and budget are invented.
conventions: Field names carry their unit, for example _m2, _m, _minutes, _seconds, _idr, _percent.
A block-level basis applies to every field in that block.
A field name that ends in _estimate is an estimate in any block.
Clock times are local time (WIB), 24-hour HH:MM, written as quoted strings.
IDs are unique across the whole file.

basis_values.confirmed: Known from a contract, the ticketing system, or a vendor roster.
basis_values.policy: Decided by the promoter, or required by the venue or the police.
basis_values.estimate: An experienced guess. Opsidio may recalibrate it after the event.
basis_values.public_source: Taken from a public source listed under sources.

Many seated ticket holders come straight from work. Friday traffic around Senayan is heavy after 17:00.
Some visitors pray Maghrib (about 17:50) at the venue prayer room or Masjid Al-Bina before they join a gate queue.

applies_to_values.visitors_with_exception: Visitors that another step sends to the help desk.

outcome_values.continue: Goes on to the next step after the extra time.
outcome_values.step_aside_and_return: Leaves the lane, fixes the issue, and rejoins the same queue.
outcome_values.secondary_check: Gets a longer check in the same lane.
outcome_values.locker_point: Goes to the locker point, then back to the gate queue.
outcome_values.redirect_to_correct_gate: Walks to the gate for the ticket category.

field_notes.typical: Seconds for a normal visitor, from the start of service to the end.
field_notes.slow: Seconds for a slow but normal visitor, without an exception.
field_notes.share_percent: Share of visitors at this step who meet the exception.
field_notes.extra_minutes: Time the exception adds at this step, before the outcome.

steps.name: E-ticket scan
steps.what_happens: Crew scans the dynamic QR code in the visitor's ticketing app. The system checks that the ticket is valid and unused.
slow_when: The phone screen is dim or cracked.
The visitor must log in to the app first.
Mobile data is weak in the crowd.

exceptions.what: The QR code is invalid, already used, or for another event.
The visitor cannot open the ticket in the app.

steps.name: KTP name match
steps.what_happens: Crew checks that the name on the original ID matches the ticket holder and that the photo matches the visitor.
slow_when: The ID is deep in a wallet or a bag.
The name on the ticket has a different spelling.
The visitor first shows a photo of the ID on a phone.
rules: Only original physical IDs are accepted.
A visitor aged 12 to 16 shows the companion's ID and ticket.

exceptions.what: Someone redeems for the buyer and brings the proxy documents.
The name does not match and there are no proxy documents.
The visitor has no original ID.
A minor arrives with a companion whose ID and ticket must be checked too.

steps.name: Wristband fitting
steps.what_happens: Crew picks the wristband color for the category and closes it on the visitor's wrist. The wristband carries a QR code for the gate scan.
slow_when: The visitor asks for a looser fit.
A group of friends wants to be served together.
rules: One wristband per person. A broken or removed wristband is not replaced after entry.

exceptions.what: The clasp breaks or the size is wrong.

steps.name: Locker drop-off
steps.what_happens: The attendant takes the item, takes payment, and gives a claim tag.
slow_when: The visitor pays in cash and needs change.
rules: When every locker unit is full, visitors must take prohibited items away from the venue.

exceptions.what: The QRIS payment fails and the visitor has no cash.

steps.name: Bag check
steps.what_happens: An officer opens the bag on the table, checks it by hand and by eye, and removes the caps from plastic bottles.
slow_when: The bag is full or has many pockets.
The visitor carries merchandise or a power bank with cables.

exceptions.what: A prohibited item is found and the visitor drops it in the amnesty bin.
A prohibited item is found and the visitor wants to keep it.
The bag is larger than A4.

steps.name: Body search
steps.what_happens: An officer of the same gender pats the visitor down lightly and passes a hand-held metal detector over the body.
slow_when: The visitor wears a jacket or many accessories.
The wand alarms on a belt or jewelry.
rules: Female visitors are searched only by female officers.
Officers never ask a visitor to remove a hijab.
A visitor can ask for a search behind a screen.

exceptions.what: The wand alarms and the officer checks again.
The visitor asks for a search behind a screen.

steps.name: Wristband check at the gate
steps.what_happens: Door crew scans the wristband QR code. The scan counts the entry and confirms that the category matches the gate.
slow_when: The wristband is under a sleeve.
The scanner loses its network link and works offline.

exceptions.what: The ticket category belongs to another gate.
The QR code on the wristband does not scan.
The visitor skipped the redemption tent.

steps.name: Help desk case
steps.what_happens: An agent checks proxy documents, used or invalid QR codes, and ID problems. A supervisor makes the final decision when needed.
slow_when: The agent must call the ticket buyer.
Several tickets in one order have problems.
steps.after_resolution: The agent fits the wristband. The visitor then goes to the locker point or the gate.

steps.name: Assisted entry
steps.what_happens: An escort meets the visitor, guides them through the priority lane, and takes them to the platform or the seat.
slow_when: The visitor arrives at a far parking area.

roles.name: Crowd marshal
duties: Send visitors to the right gate.
Hold a line when its queue pen is full.

roles.name: Runner
duties: Bring spare scanners, batteries, and wristbands.
Help visitors open the ticket app.

roles.name: Medical team
duties: Keep one ambulance at the drop-off lane.

keep_clear: The ambulance route to the drop-off lane
safety.rain_plan: Put both rain tents over the floor queue pen. They cover 200 of its 540 m2.
safety.lightning_plan: Move open-air queues to covered areas and pause the gate lanes that are open to the sky.

items.rule: Female visitors are body-searched only by female officers.
Only certified security staff do bag checks and body searches.
Every visitor passes the KTP name match, guests included.
A visitor who leaves cannot enter again.
Each gate has one security supervisor while it is open.
The priority gate stays open while any other gate is open.
Each person gets one meal break. At most 25% of a role is on break at once.
No briefing and no shift start between 11:30 and 12:45 (Friday prayer).

allowed_changes: Move staff between points within their can_do skills.
Change the lane count at a point within its max_lanes.
Open redemption or doors earlier within the timing limits.
Add staff from a pool within the budget and the lead time.
Rent extra equipment within the budget and the lead time.
Turn on Festival A entry waves, with queue numbers on the e-ticket from D-7.
not_allowed: Skip the KTP name match for any category.
Let a male officer body-search a female visitor.
Sell more tickets than the configured capacity.
